purpose: Acquire and inspect Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.14827784 for a future detect-then-crop pipeline. No training. No ICDAS mapping.
clinical_note: d/D = detection labels only; NOT ICDAS 0-4.

source.title: Annotated intraoral image dataset for dental caries detection

download.skip_reason: Duplicate images plus train/val/test splits; canonical tree is Dataset.zip

layout.labelme: not extracted (duplicate of boxes; YOLO kept as working format)

inspection.coco_note: train.json and valid.json use category id 1=d, 2=D. test.json inverts ids (1=D, 2=d). Do not trust COCO category ids without split-specific mapping.

iccc_verdicts.tooth_crop_caveat: Boxes are decay lesions, not whole-tooth or FDI tooth-instance masks.

future_crop_pipeline_notes: Restrict detector/crop work to the 2227 images that have YOLO/VOC labels; 4038 JPGs have no boxes.
Treat boxes as caries lesions. Pad crops; do not assume a crop is a full clinical tooth crown.
Drop or clip the 84 YOLO boxes with normalized coordinates outside [0,1] (example: center-y > 1).
Skip empty label files (126) rather than treating them as negatives unless a later protocol defines unlabeled views as ICDAS 0 (they must not).
Map Darknet YOLO id 0 -> D and id 1 -> d. Do not use COCO category ids from test.json without remapping.
Expect mixed views (Frontal, Left/Right lateral, Maxillary occlusal, Mandibular) and mixed retractor conditions.
Resolutions vary widely (about 617-4080 px); letterbox/resize at train time, do not assume a fixed camera.
Do not copy these files into dataset/train|val|test.
Do not map d or D to ICDAS 0-4.
